set.body:
Current owner-directed scope (25 October): prepare the smallest experimental adapter for C, a context-rich LLM mapping recall directly to existing structured attribution records. Do not require S3 graph completion, the S3d reader, a reviewed source graph, or successful AMR parsing. Use admitted timestamped source records and equivalent recall context, preserving annotation/visual/transcript origins. Return cited source/recall anchors, referent alternatives, role, occurrence/state, context, separate detail findings, unresolved/external outcomes and failure stages. Preserve participant-stated vs system-inferred detail; do not repair omissions or distortions into recall credit.

Acceptance: pinned prompt/model/config/input/output contract, runnable small adapter and source/target/anchor checks, positive and negative S1 controls including wrong-role/context and omitted-detail cases. Structural checks do not prove semantic truth. Outputs are experimental proposals, not newly licensed production claims. C-ready adapter is this slice's completion witness; A/B/D shared-binder comparison is subsequent S6 scope, using S3 only where needed. Preserve original S5 graph-binder requirements in history; production integration follows measured results and applicable ADR decisions.

S0/S1 and existing data/spend permissions remain. Frozen population, references and utility gate are governed by docs/plans/2026-10-25-identity-feasibility-codex.md at 8553e728a.
set.title: [evidence-binding S5] Direct attribution adapter with evidence-bound structured outputs
